mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_agent_create_receipts(request_id,tenant_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{tenant},#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_create_receipts SET agent_id=#{agentId} WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND agent_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,agent_id::text AS agent_id FROM nw_agent_create_receipts WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
